qos_d21_error_budget.interpretation: The final D.21 paragraph states n+ceil(log2(s_r))<=2n approximate counter-oracle uses and sets epsilon_2=epsilon/n. Under the standard telescoping/triangle accounting with an epsilon_2 error per use, that displayed choice alone gives up to (1+m/n)epsilon rather than epsilon. Replacing it by epsilon/(n+m) repairs this constant accounting without changing asymptotic order.

qos_d20_downstream_visible_sensitivity.interpretation: The specific D.183 sqrt(R) arithmetic correction from Batch 029 is a bounded constant-factor change on the nondegenerate uniform-support regime. This does not repair the separate D.20 history-selected-coordinate issue and does not establish D.21/D.23 validity.
